capabilities: Opens the current note in a dedicated writing view with font and line-height controls
Lists sibling Markdown files as a chapter list and switches between them
Generates and inserts local Chinese and English names and place names
Snapshots the draft every ~100 new characters and restores snapshots after showing a line diff
Exports the current chapter or the whole chapter list to Word or UTF-8 TXT
disambiguation: Not a general productivity or project workbench; it is a dedicated drafting view for long-form fiction.
extras: Bilingual Chinese/English README; the first-line indent option and name generator are aimed at Chinese-language drafting. Backups and names stay local with no API key or network request. A roadmap lists planned features such as in-chapter search and per-project writing goals.
motivation: The author wanted a writing table rather than a writing prison: a narrower drafting surface with easy chapter jumps and on-hand name ideas, while keeping the manuscript as plain Markdown.
problem: Drafting long fiction in Obsidian's default editor means a page that feels too wide, awkward chapter switching, and no help when a temporary character name stalls the writing.
summary: Focused novel-writing workspace with a chapter list, local name generator, snapshot backups, live stats and Word/TXT export.
